import pandas as pd
import tempfile

name='ser = pd.Series(range(2), index=pd.Index([np.nan, np.nan], dtype=str)); ser.to_hdf(temp_h5_path, key="s", mode="w", format=fmt) for fmt in ["fixed", "table"]; then pd.read_hdf(temp_h5_path, "s")'

try:

            ser = pd.Series(range(2), index=pd.Index([np.nan, np.nan], dtype=str))
            ser.to_hdf(temp_h5_path, key="s", mode="w", format=fmt)
            out = pd.read_hdf(temp_h5_path, "s")
            results.append(out)

        probe(name, results)
except Exception as e:
    probe_exception(name, e)
